For S1, the factory network is usually RMS1-XXXXXX and the initial password is 12341234. In Direct mode, hold the robot Connect button for 5 seconds to reset a forgotten password.
The router must use WPA/WPA2-PSK and allow devices to communicate. Networks requiring web sign-in are unsupported. The entire flow works without the official RoboMaster app.

Loop the opening phrase of Lan Hua Cao while cruising with blue water lights, then park. Keep 2 m clear ahead; no firing.
A red countdown, orange ignition, blue cruise and a starry orbital finale; lights and sound only.
Dusk fades into answering fireflies, soft notes and a gentle nightfall; no movement.
Center the gimbal, greet visitors left and right, nod and ring a golden welcome; chassis stays still.
Two three-beat phrases with side steps and gentle turns under violet light. Keep 1 m clear around the robot.
Depart with a bell, visit forest, seaside, stars and home along four short legs. Keep 1 m clear around the robot.
Wake from a dim yawn, check the battery mood and play a morning tune, or return to sleep if tired; no movement.
Warm the griddle, chop in rhythm, flash through a sizzling stir-fry and ring the serving bell; no movement.
Make two sideways saves: recover from a wrong guess, then celebrate a clean save. Keep 1 m clear on each side.
Wait at red, check both sides with the gimbal, open the green light and close with amber; chassis stays still.
Ticks and red flashes accelerate, then a last-second silence gives way to a green all-clear; lights and sound only.

Tribute to Beck Martin\'s legendary \'Friday Night\' audition on The X Factor: smoke machine blasts, gym instructor groove, side shuffles, sky pointing, and a 360 spin as judges dance along. Keep 1.5 m clear around the robot.

Support the robot securely with all four wheels off the ground. Turn the wheels by hand in this order: front right, front left, rear left, rear right. Keep all wheels raised during the powered position checks.
Keep the robot still. This process addresses the four chassis armor plates. Tap them one at a time in this order: rear, front, left, right, waiting for feedback after each tap.

Disconnect the servo to be numbered. Keep the existing arm and installed modules connected. After starting, wait for existing modules to become silent, then connect one servo at a time. Installation IDs are 1–3.
Disconnect the ToF sensor to be numbered. Keep installed modules connected. After starting, wait for existing modules to become silent, then connect one sensor at a time. IDs are 1–4.
Sensor adapters are numbered with their onboard button. This guide sends no remote assignment command. Connect the adapter, select its intended ID, and follow the indicator pattern.
Confirm that only one module awaiting an ID is connected. After the write is acknowledged, existing modules become silent again before you connect the next one. Leaving does not undo an ID write.
This step will be recorded as skipped, not as a verified position. Check the armor installation and numbering after ending the task.
End numbering, stop tests, and release control. Existing ID writes are retained. An end acknowledgement does not replace checking the physical positions and IDs.
This only closes the guide; it does not undo the onboard setting. The adapter saves its ID about 5 seconds after the last button press. Check the steady indicators and actual ID.
